# Viewing a Table Reservation Dashboard

* **Go to POS >>Transactions >> Table reservations.**

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (249).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

When you click the **Table Reservation** menu, the **Table Reservation Dashboard** appears, providing an overview of all table bookings, availability, and reservation management options.

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (250).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

The dashboard for table reservations displays:

{% stepper %}
{% step %}
**Future dates.**

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (255).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
**The meal sessions.**

<div align="left"><figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (256).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure></div>

* RC: Round the Clock&#x20;
* BF: Breakfast&#x20;
* Lunch
* ES: Evening Snacks&#x20;
* DN: Dinner&#x20;

#### <mark style="color:blue;">Creating a Meal Session</mark>

* Go to Point of sale >> Masters1 >> POS Session &#x20;
* Click on the Open file icon <img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/unknown (7).png" alt="" data-size="line">&#x20;
* Click on the plus icon (+) to create a meal session.&#x20;

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (257).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

* Enter the session name, serial number, and the start and end time of the session.
* Enter the sequence number. This number specifies the position of the session within the sessions bar on the dashboard. _Keep the serial number and session number the same_.
* Check the Applicable box to keep the session active for the outlet.&#x20;
* Save using the save icon<img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" data-size="line">.&#x20;
* To delete a session, use the Trash can at the end of each record.
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### To Outlet

<div align="left"><figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (258).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure></div>
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### Time

Each column represents an hour. The displayed time corresponds to the session selected on the dashboard. _For example, if the 'Lunch' session is selected, the time allotted for lunch will be displayed_.

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (246).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
### Availability Row

This row displays the real-time availability of tables. The number decreases as bookings are made. _In the screenshot below, 42 tables are available at 11:00 AM and 41 tables at 12:00 PM, indicating that one table has been booked._

<figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (247).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}
{% endstepper %}

The left panel of the dashboard displays the real-time status of the tables.

<div align="left"><figure><img src="../../../.gitbook/assets/image (248).png" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure></div>
